hook: Mount your iPhone on Linux, no cable needed

beats.say: iphone-linux makes an iPhone appear as a normal Linux folder over Wi-Fi, with full read and write access and no Apple account.
It combines FUSE with the same wireless protocol Xcode uses for debugging, because the old USB route with ifuse is broken on iOS 17 and later.
You can copy photos out of DCIM, write files, or mount a single app's Documents folder, as long as the phone has Developer Mode on.
